spindle.observe.Liveness.title: Liveness
spindle.observe.Liveness.description: The answer of `GET /__spindle/live`, with or without `--observe` and without the host's thread, beside its status: `200` while the run's thread asked the listener for a request within the bound, `503` once it has not. The bound of a served run is 60 s, above the 30 s an external call may take, so a command held by one does not read as a run that stopped.

idle_ms.description: Milliseconds since the run's thread last asked for a request.
